target.value: one creature/level, within 30 ft. of each other

description.summary: The affected creatures gain greater vitality and stamina
description.value: The affected creatures gain greater vitality and stamina. The spell grants the subjects a +6 enhancement bonus to Constitution, which adds the usual benefits to hit points, Fortitude saves, Constitution checks, and so forth. Hit points gained by a temporary increase in Constitution score are not temporary hit points. They go away when the subject’s Constitution drops back to normal. They are not lost first as temporary hit points are.
